name: Random Events
summary: About 60 random events can happen around San Andreas; any 14 count toward 100% completion. GamePressure documents them by name; per-event locations, rewards and protagonist restrictions are mostly not documented.

sections.title: Event names documented by GamePressure
sections.text: Getaway driver; Bike thief; Sport bike thief; Construction site accident; Mugging; Countryside robbery; Prisoner lift; Crash rescue; Drunk driver; Deal gone wrong; Border patrol; Car theft; Chase thieves (city and country); Gang intimidation; Store robbery; Hitchhiker (4 variants); Security vans (10); Drug shootout; Altruist cult shootout; and others such as domestic dispute, ATM robbery, burial, snatched, bus tour and stag do.

sections.title: Specifics that are documented
sections.text: The Altruist cult shootout is Trevor-specific. The hitchhiker events have an alternative outcome where you deliver hitchhikers to the Altruist cult; one hidden package requires bringing three hitchhikers there. Whether each event repeats is not documented.
